item.title: Oil prices jump, stocks slip as Trump's Iran claims raise doubts
item.description: Oil prices, which had tumbled on Monday, rebounded strongly, with Brent popping back above $100 a barrel.

item.title: India sentences Kashmiri resistance leader Asiya to life imprisonment
item.description: Her associates, Sofi Fehmeeda and Nahida Nasreen, were sentenced to 30 years in prison under the infamous Unlawful Activities (Prevention) Act (UAPA).

item.title: Pakistan 'ready' to host talks to end US-Israeli war on Iran
item.description: Pakistan is positioning itself as a central mediator in the crisis, with reports suggesting Islamabad may host a summit later this week aimed at brokering a truce.

item.title: Former Israeli PM slams rabbinical laws, rejects 'state within a state'
item.description: Bennett criticises the Netanyahu government, saying expanded powers for religious courts harm civil rights.

item.title: Talks better than fighting, China tells Iran
item.description: The Iranian foreign minister said vessels could "safely pass through" the strait, except those belonging to "countries currently engaging in conflict", the statement added.

item.title: Türkiye and UK deepen defence ties with new Eurofighter support deal
item.description: Fresh agreement secures long-term maintenance of Typhoon jets as Ankara and London expand strategic military cooperation.

item.title: Hungary to phase out gas deliveries to Ukraine amid pipeline dispute
item.description: Ukraine says Russian strikes halted Druzhba pipeline flows, but Hungary and Slovakia allege deliberate blockage and have suspended diesel supplies in retaliation.

item.title: Diego Garcia: The remote island at the heart of America's wars, and now Britain's too
item.description: Britain has allowed the US to launch strikes from its military bases following a contested missile strike in the Indian Ocean. At the centre of it all is a tiny atoll most people have never heard of.

item.title: Casualties feared after bus plunges into Bangladesh's Padma River
item.description: The bus fell into the river while boarding the ferry in the central Rajbari district.

item.title: Turkish FM holds calls with counterparts on Middle East war, de-escalation efforts
item.description: Hakan Fidan discussed trajectory of the conflict and efforts to halt hostilities in talks with officials from China, Syria, Qatar and Uzbekistan.

item.title: Conservatives converge for CPAC with American right openly split over US-Israel war on Iran
item.description: Thousands of activists, influencers and Republican lawmakers gather at Conservative Political Action Conference outside Dallas. Among those slated to speak are big names in MAGA movement who have voiced conflicting views on Iran war.

item.title: China well-placed to withstand Hormuz closure aftershocks, but for how long?
item.description: The world’s second-largest economy is also the top oil importer, and disruptions due to the Iran war will likely impact the Asian giant despite plenty of buffer stock.

item.title: Here are five conditions that Iran laid to negotiate end of war
item.description: The official said Iran will decide when the war ends and will press on with its response, vowing to continue inflicting "heavy blows until its conditions are met.

item.title: Republican House speaker says US-led war on Iran 'almost done' despite new troop deployment by Trump
item.description: Asked about US order to push thousands more troops near Iran, Mike Johnson says new buildup of American troops is "very different" than boots on the ground.

item.title: Pakistan slams India over jail terms for Kashmiri women leaders
item.description: The case adds to a series of prosecutions of Kashmiri political figures, including Qasim Faktoo and Yasin Malik, who received life sentences under similar charges.
